groups.name: Getting hired on campus
groups.blurb: The portal, the wage floor, and the two rules that decide which campus jobs you can actually hold.

items.name: ASU Hourly Employment Program
items.unit: ASU Student Employment, Business and Finance
items.pay: Hourly. The student wage scale starts at $14.70 an hour for FY2027
items.hours: Up to an average of 25 hours a week across all jobs over a rolling 12 months. You may not work during hours you are scheduled to be in class
items.eligibility: Enrolled in one or more credit hours. US citizens and eligible noncitizens. F-1 students must be enrolled full time, which is 12 credits for undergraduates
items.cycle: Year round. New jobs post daily
items.note: This is the program most campus jobs actually sit in, and the hiring department pays the whole wage, so there is no award to qualify for first. If you are starting at ASU in the fall you can begin working in the summer as soon as you register for fall classes.
items.evidence: Explore Employment Opportunities | Arizona State University, HTTP 200

items.name: Federal Work-Study
items.unit: ASU Student Employment with Financial Aid and Scholarship Services
items.pay: Hourly, on the same wage scale as hourly employment, capped at the size of your award
items.hours: Part time. You stop earning against the award once you hit the award total
items.eligibility: A completed FAFSA, a demonstrated need, and an FWS award shown on your Financial Aid Notification in My ASU. If it is not on your FAN you can file a Federal Work-Study Adjustment Form
items.cycle: Awarded with your financial aid package each year. Jobs are applied for separately all year
items.note: Work-study is financial aid, not a job type, and it is the single biggest reason people get turned away from a campus posting. Check your FAN before you apply to anything marked work-study only, and know that the award is a ceiling: once you earn it out, your department can keep you on hourly but does not have to.
items.evidence: Federal work-study | Student Employment at ASU, HTTP 200

items.name: Student wage scale, levels I to IV
items.unit: ASU Student Employment
items.pay: Level I $14.70 to $15.40, level II $15.10 to $16.57, level III $15.97 to $18.97, level IV $17.75 to $50.85, all Arizona rates effective July 6, 2026
items.eligibility: Applies to every ASU student hourly position
items.cycle: Reset each fiscal year in July
items.note: Read this before you accept anything. Level I is the entry desk job, level IV is reserved for teaching and research aide work and specialised skills, and the gap between them is real money. If a posting is graded below the duties it describes, that is a fair thing to raise with the supervisor.
items.evidence: Standard wage scale | Student Employment at ASU, HTTP 200

items.name: On-campus employment rules for F-1 and J-1 students
items.unit: ASU Student Employment with the International Students and Scholars Center
items.pay: Same wage scale as any other student
items.hours: 20 hours a week in fall and spring, 40 in summer and over winter and spring break, combined across every job. You cannot average 18 one week and 22 the next
items.eligibility: F-1 and J-1 students in valid status, enrolled full time. Undergraduate full time is 12 credit hours
items.cycle: Year round
items.note: If you are on F-1 you can work on campus when you cannot work off it, so this list is worth knowing line by line. ASU hourly, stipend, TA and RA roles are all open to you, and so are Aramark dining and the Follett bookstore even though they are outside companies. Federal work-study is not, and nor is Education at Work, which needs CPT or OPT.
items.evidence: On campus employment types for international student employment at ASU, HTTP 200

items.name: ASU CareerLink
items.unit: ASU Career Services
items.pay: Varies by posting
items.eligibility: Current students and alumni who graduated 2023 or later, log in with ASURITE. Earlier alumni request access
items.cycle: Year round
items.note: This is the current platform and it is not Handshake. Plenty of ASU pages, advisors and older advice still point at Handshake, so if a friend tells you to check there you will be looking at the wrong board. Campus jobs post on the student employment portal, everything else posts here.
items.evidence: ASU CareerLink | Career services, HTTP 200

items.name: Student Employment Project Portal
items.unit: University College, Work+, run on Riipen
items.pay: Paid per project on approval of your deliverables, by direct deposit
items.hours: Short term projects. Most fall projects run mid September to early December
items.eligibility: Any ASU student enrolled in at least one credit hour. Some projects ask for specific coursework. A Social Security Number is required
items.cycle: By semester, most fall projects start mid September
items.note: This is the one on the list that is not a job. ASU departments post short paid projects and you deliver a piece of work, which means a first-year student with no employment history can put a real deliverable on a resume in one semester. You need an SSN before you can take one, so international students should sort that first.
items.evidence: Student Employment Project Portal | University College, HTTP 200

groups.name: Getting paid for coursework you already did
groups.blurb: These hire on the grade you earned in one specific course, not on your overall GPA, which is why they are the fastest route from finishing a class to being paid for it.

items.name: Tutor, ASU Tutoring Centers
items.unit: Academic Support Network
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.eligibility: Currently enrolled undergraduate or graduate student. Local ASU Online students taking courses at ASU may apply
items.cycle: Postings stay open past their listed close date and are reviewed on a rolling basis until filled
items.note: Ignore the close date on the requisition, they keep reviewing until the seats are gone. As of 2026-09-15 the Tempe tutor posting JR105258 and the West Valley one JR104918 were both marked hiring, and you apply by requisition number on the student employment portal rather than through this page.
items.evidence: Student Employment | Academic Support Network, HTTP 200

items.name: Writing Tutor, ASU Writing Centers
items.unit: Academic Support Network
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.eligibility: Currently enrolled undergraduate. Tutors come from a wide range of majors, not only English
items.cycle: Rolling, reviewed until filled
items.note: You do not need to be an English major and the centers say so outright, they want tutors from across the disciplines because a finance student writing a case memo wants someone who has written one. Sessions run on Zoom as well as in person on all four campuses.
items.evidence: Writing Centers | Academic Support Network, HTTP 200

items.name: Supplemental Instruction Leader
items.unit: Academic Support Network
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.hours: Attend every class session of the course plus facilitate three or more study sessions a week, after 10 hours of training
items.eligibility: Completed the course with a B- (2.77) or better, currently enrolled, in academic good standing. Interview required. Online SI Leader roles are open to students anywhere in the US
items.cycle: Rolling, reviewed until filled. SI is attached to courses with high D, E and withdrawal rates
items.note: The bar is a B- in that one course, not your GPA, so a rough first semester in something else does not shut this door. It is also the closest thing on campus to paid practice at standing in front of a room, which is the skill most business students say they lack.
items.evidence: Supplemental Instruction | Academic Support Network, HTTP 200

items.name: Desk Aide, Tutoring and Writing Centers
items.unit: Academic Support Network
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.eligibility: Currently enrolled student who holds a Federal Work-Study award
items.cycle: Rolling, reviewed until filled
items.note: This is the only role in the Academic Support Network that requires a work-study award, and the page says so in one line most people skim past. No award means no hire here, and because work-study is closed to F-1 students, this desk job is closed to them too. The tutor and SI roles on the same page are not.
items.evidence: Student Employment | Academic Support Network, HTTP 200

items.name: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
items.unit: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering, PULSE
items.pay: Stipend, paid biweekly through the assignment. Amount not stated on the program page
items.hours: About 5 hours a week of office hours, study sessions and asynchronous support
items.eligibility: A B or higher in the course you would support, at least one completed semester at ASU, currently enrolled as a Fulton Schools undergraduate, good academic standing with no integrity violations
items.cycle: By semester through the UGTA and Section Leader portal
items.note: Two applications, not one. The portal gets you the course assignment and the offer letter, then you have to apply separately to the Student Employment Office or you are not actually hired. The program also tells you plainly to ask a faculty member to request you, which matters more than the form does.
items.evidence: UGTA - ASU Engineering Student Hub, HTTP 200

items.name: ASU 101 Section Leader
items.unit: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering, PULSE
items.pay: Stipend. Amount not stated on the program page
items.eligibility: Same portal and broadly the same bar as the UGTA role: a completed ASU semester, current Fulton Schools undergraduate, good academic standing
items.cycle: By semester, applications run alongside the UGTA cycle
items.note: You teach the first-year seminar to people a year behind you, which is the earliest point in a degree where anyone will pay you to run a room. Note that the application banner on this page still reads Fall 2025, so email the program address rather than assuming the cycle is closed.
items.evidence: UGTA - ASU Engineering Student Hub, HTTP 200

items.name: Instructional Assistant or Grader, mathematics
items.unit: School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.eligibility: Check the site. Apply through the school's own GIA application, not through a professor
items.cycle: Check the site
items.note: SoMSS faculty do not hire their own graders, which means asking your professor gets you nowhere and the only route in is the GIA portal at math.la.asu.edu/gia. Grading is the quietest paid academic job on campus and it stacks with a full course load better than anything front of house.
items.evidence: Employment Opportunities | School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences, HTTP 200

groups.name: Paid research on campus
groups.blurb: Research that pays rather than research for credit, which is a distinction worth making before you commit a semester to it.

items.name: Fulton Undergraduate Research Initiative (FURI)
items.unit: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering
items.pay: $1,500 stipend per funded semester, paid at the end of the semester, plus up to $400 in research supplies
items.hours: Check the site. You run one project across a semester and present at the FURI Expo
items.eligibility: Full-time Fulton Schools undergraduate in good academic standing, from your second semester at ASU through your last
items.cycle: Twice a year. Fall 2026 applications opened September 16. The spring cycle has historically closed in mid October and the fall cycle in April
items.note: The application is a real research proposal with a named faculty mentor, so the work starts weeks before the deadline, and generative AI is banned for every part of it including the personal statement. Find the mentor first by going to office hours, because the proposal is the easy half.
items.evidence: FURI homepage - ASU Engineering Student Hub, HTTP 200. Stipend and supply figures confirmed on the FURI announcement at innercircle.engineering.asu.edu, HTTP 200

items.name: New College Undergraduate Inquiry and Research Experiences (NCUIRE)
items.unit: New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences, West Valley campus
items.pay: A small stipend or course credit, depending on the track. Amount not stated
items.eligibility: Undergraduates majoring in a New College program. Separate applications for research assistant, research team, and scholars and fellows
items.cycle: By semester. The fall 2026 deadline was extended to April 27
items.note: Three different applications sit behind one program name and they are not interchangeable, so read which one you are filling in. The research assistant track is the entry point and it pairs you with a faculty member rather than asking you to arrive with a project of your own.
items.evidence: NCUIRE | New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences, HTTP 200

items.name: Student Strategic Research Analyst
items.unit: ASU Foundation for A New American University
items.pay: Check the site
items.eligibility: Check the site
items.cycle: Posted as a requisition. R1498 was live on 2026-09-15, posted 22 days earlier
items.note: Prospect research for a fundraising shop, which is closer to equity research than to a lab, and it is one of the few genuinely analytical paid student roles on campus. The Foundation is a separate nonprofit from ASU, so if you are on F-1 confirm with the ISSC that it counts as on-campus employment before you accept.
items.evidence: Search for Jobs (ASU Foundation Workday), HTTP 200, 18 jobs found rendered, one of them this student role

groups.name: Student leadership and front of house
groups.blurb: Roles where the job is other students, and where the hiring cycle runs a full year ahead of the work.

items.name: Community Assistant
items.unit: University Housing and Residential Life
items.pay: Check the site. The role requires you to live in the residence halls for its duration
items.hours: Classified by ASU HR as a 20 hour a week position. You may work only 5 more hours anywhere else on campus outside EOSS
items.eligibility: Sophomore standing or above by August 2026, enrolled full time, cumulative and semester GPA of 2.75 or higher, 3.0 for Barrett communities and graduate students, in good standing with Housing and Student Rights
items.cycle: Applications opened November 1 and closed at 3pm on December 1 for the following August. Interviews in February, offers through March
items.note: This closes in the first week of December for a job that starts the following August, which is nine months of lead time and the reason most people miss it. Two steps, not one: the Workday requisition and a separate Student Staff Interest Form, both due December 1. The 20 hour classification also eats almost your whole allowance, so it is not a job you stack another job on top of.
items.evidence: ASU Housing Student Employment | Arizona State University, HTTP 200

items.name: Peer Academic Leader
items.unit: Barrett, The Honors College, Tempe campus
items.pay: Check the site
items.eligibility: Barrett students. Two PALs serve each academic college community including a dedicated W. P. Carey community
items.cycle: Check the site. Contact the program coordinator named on the page
items.note: There is a W. P. Carey specific PAL seat, so if you are a Barrett business student this is a leadership role aimed squarely at you rather than at the general population. PALs serve second and third year students, which means the people hired are usually third and fourth years.
items.evidence: Peer Academic Leaders | Barrett Students | ASU, HTTP 200

items.name: Gold Guide
items.unit: ASU New Student Experience, Educational Outreach and Student Services
items.pay: Check the site
items.eligibility: Check the site. Undergraduate student staff
items.cycle: Check the site. Work concentrates around orientation and the onboarding season
items.note: Gold Guides are paired one to one with incoming students and message them through the whole onboarding run, so the job is sustained relationship building rather than a weekend of event work. It is one of the few campus roles where a first year with nothing on a resume is exactly the person they want.
items.evidence: Student Leaders | Educational Outreach and Student Services, HTTP 200

items.name: Campus tour guide, Devils' Advocates
items.unit: ASU Admission Services
items.pay: Check the site
items.hours: Check the site. Tours run Monday through Saturday
items.eligibility: Check the site
items.cycle: Check the site
items.note: Devils' Advocates has been a club since 1966 but it moved under Admission Services in 2024 and its guides are student workers now, not volunteers. That means you look for it on the ASU student employment portal, not on the club listings, and it is the cheapest public speaking practice you will ever be paid for.
items.evidence: Campus Tour | Arizona State University, HTTP 200

items.name: Sun Devil Fitness Complex student staff
items.unit: Sun Devil Fitness, Educational Outreach and Student Services
items.pay: Check the site. See the note below before you trust the table on the campus job pages
items.eligibility: Check the site. Roles run from lifeguard and facility assistant up to supervisor and manager, with some marked as needing prior experience
items.cycle: Rolling. Each campus page marks roles hiring or not hiring. On 2026-09-15 Tempe listed lifeguard, lifeguard instructor, water safety instructor, intramural official and sport club supervisor as hiring
items.note: The hourly rates printed on the campus job tables run from $8.00 to $15.00, which is below Arizona minimum wage and below ASU's own $14.70 student floor, so the table is stale and you should ask what the role actually pays. Promotion from within is the real draw here: facility assistant to supervisor to manager is a documented ladder inside four years.
items.evidence: Student Employment | Sun Devil Fitness, HTTP 200. Role and rate table read from Tempe Jobs | Sun Devil Fitness, HTTP 200

items.name: Memorial Union and Student Pavilion student staff
items.unit: Memorial Union, Educational Outreach and Student Services
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.eligibility: Check the site
items.cycle: Based on department need. Not all applicants are contacted
items.note: Eight distinct job titles sit behind one door, from Information Desk Associate to Building Manager to Graphic Design Intern, and the MU cross-trains between them. Apply for the entry desk role and you are inside the building that runs every event on campus, which is worth more than the title suggests.
items.evidence: Student Employment | Educational Outreach and Student Services, HTTP 200

groups.name: ASU enterprise employers
groups.blurb: Organisations that sit on or beside campus and hire students into named professional roles rather than into shift work.

items.name: Student Assistant roles, ASU Enterprise Partners
items.unit: ASU Enterprise Partners
items.pay: Check the site
items.eligibility: Check the site. Roles are titled for students and based in Tempe, Scottsdale or remote in Arizona
items.cycle: Rolling requisitions. On 2026-09-15 the board rendered 13 jobs, five of them student roles: Alumni Engagement, Asset Management, Data Science, Graphic Designer and Marketing Analyst Specialist
items.note: Asset Management and Data Science here are the two most finance-shaped student jobs anywhere near campus, and they carry real titles rather than assistant-of-everything. Enterprise Partners is a separate nonprofit and not ASU itself, so on F-1 check the ISSC acceptable on-campus employer list before you accept.
items.evidence: Search for Jobs (ASU Enterprise Partners Workday), HTTP 200, 13 jobs found rendered

items.name: ASU Library student positions
items.unit: ASU Library
items.pay: Check the site. Student hourly wage scale applies
items.eligibility: Check the site
items.cycle: As posted. The library page routes student roles to the ASU Student Employment portal
items.note: The library page itself mostly lists librarian and staff recruitments, so do not read an empty student section as no jobs. The student roles live on the student employment portal and the quiet shifts are why this is the classic first-year job for people carrying a heavy course load.
items.evidence: Employment opportunities - ASU Library, HTTP 200

items.name: Sun Devil Hospitality, operated by Aramark
items.unit: Aramark at ASU Campus Dining
items.pay: Check the site
items.hours: Check the site. Aramark schedules do not match ASU pay periods
items.eligibility: Check the site. Cashier, food service and sales ambassador roles
items.cycle: Rolling, heaviest at the start of each semester
items.note: Aramark is one of the two outside companies ASU names as permitted on-campus employment for F-1 students, alongside the Follett bookstore, which makes it genuinely useful if the portal keeps routing you to work-study jobs. You apply on Aramark's own careers site, not the ASU portal, and if you are on F-1 you still count your hours Monday to Sunday no matter what Aramark's week looks like.
items.evidence: Aramark Careers | Explore Jobs and Opportunities, HTTP 200. Permitted employer status and the Monday to Sunday rule confirmed on studentemployment.asu.edu international student pages, HTTP 200

groups.name: Career development inside W. P. Carey
groups.blurb: The school's own career operation, which is where business-specific coaching and employer access sit.

items.name: W. P. Carey Career Services Center
items.unit: W. P. Carey School of Business
items.pay: Check the site
items.eligibility: W. P. Carey undergraduates, on campus and 100% online, plus alumni
items.cycle: Coaching year round. Employer events cluster in September and February
items.note: No student staff posting was listed here on 2026-09-15, so treat this as the place to be known rather than a place to apply: its Career Management Program is the structured route business students get and almost nobody uses it in their first two years. Its events calendar ran seven separate sessions on September 15 alone.
items.evidence: W. P. Carey Career Services Center | Arizona State University W. P. Carey School of Business, HTTP 200

notes_for_integration: 26 opportunities across six groups, every link fetched with a browser User-Agent on 2026-09-15 and confirmed 200 with a sensible first-title match. Two sites needed a rendered check: both ASU Enterprise Partners and ASU Foundation are Workday and returned nothing to curl, so they were opened in Playwright and the rendered counts were 13 and 18 jobs respectively. REJECTED AND WHY. adams.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/ASU looks like an ASU careers tenant and is not, it is Adams State University in Alamosa, Colorado, 22 postings, all Colorado. Sun Devil Athletics internships at sundevils.com/about/jobs-internships are verified 200 but the page states plainly that they are unpaid with course credit only, and the 26-27 Sun Devil Club cycle is already closed, so they do not belong on a board about paid work. ASU Enterprise Technology at tech.asu.edu/working-at-Enterprise-Tech is live but describes only professional hiring with no student role named, so an IT help desk item could not be written honestly. EdPlus at edplus.asu.edu/careers is live but every posting on it was a full-time professional role. ASU Police Department at cfo.asu.edu/police-recruitment lists Police Aide and Dispatcher as entry-level civilian jobs but never names a student cadet programme, and the only student-facing thing on offer is an unpaid volunteer programme. The campus bookstore is named by ASU as a permitted F-1 employer as Follett, but bookstore.asu.edu redirects to bkstr.com and no vendor careers page resolved, so no bookstore item was written. sundevilhospitality.asu.edu/employment returns 403 in Playwright as well as in curl, so it is genuinely restricted and not a CDN block, and the Aramark item points at careers.aramark.com instead. NOT CONFIRMED. W. P. Carey says many WPC 101 sections are taught by current students but publishes no application or stipend for that role, so it is not on the board. The ASU Student Success Center has a hiring page that contains only a contact form. Devils' Advocates moving from club to paid Admission Services staff in 2024 is sourced to The Arizona State Press, not to an ASU page, so the item links to visit.asu.edu/campus-tour and the pay reads Check the site. Pay figures were taken only where printed: the $14.70 FY2027 floor and the four wage levels, the $1,500 FURI stipend plus $400 supplies, and nothing else. The Sun Devil Fitness rate tables print $8.00 to $15.00, which is below both Arizona minimum wage and ASU's own floor, so those numbers are flagged as stale in the note rather than reported as pay. The UGTA and ASU 101 Section Leader stipend amounts circulating as $1,000 and $500 per section could not be confirmed because online-students.engineering.asu.edu returned 522 on two attempts, so both read Check the site. WORK STUDY. Exactly one role on this board requires an award, Desk Aide in the Tutoring and Writing Centers, and that is stated on the same page that says tutors and SI leaders do not need one. F-1. ASU states directly that federal work-study is not permitted for F-1 and J-1 students, which closes Desk Aide to them, and that Aramark dining and the Follett bookstore do count as on-campus employment, which opens two outside employers. The 20 hour fall and spring cap cannot be averaged across a two-week pay period. ASU Enterprise Partners and the ASU Foundation are separate nonprofits, so their F-1 status is marked not stated and each note tells the student to check the ISSC acceptable on-campus employer list rather than assume. Also worth knowing before this ships: ASU has moved from Handshake to ASU CareerLink on 12twenty, and older ASU pages still point at Handshake.
